target_implemented_capabilities: Five primary workbench routes plus library/history/settings
Generation Spec builder, validation, and prompt compiler
Zustand workflow state for assets, identities, templates, jobs, batch rows, constraints, and local edit context
Electron IPC for generation start/submit/cancel, settings, asset import, snapshot, export, and Codex diagnostics
Local runtime folders under Electron userData or configured runtimeRoot
Project manifest persistence for runtime assets and jobs
Original image copy on import and thumbnail generation attempt through nativeImage
Mock provider and Codex CLI provider using result-manifest.json contract

target_unfinished_or_unproven_capabiliti.reason: Codex CLI is only an execution wrapper. It can fall back to SVG diagnostic outputs and does not guarantee GPT Image, Flux, ComfyUI, or another real raster model.
Constraints are encoded in Generation Spec and prompt text, but there is no visual/OCR/segmentation QA to verify collar, sleeve, hem, logo, pattern, color, or fabric preservation.
Face identity UI/state exists, but runtime persistence currently persists assets and jobs only, not durable identity/template libraries.
Reference role separation exists in spec, but real scene generation quality is provider-dependent and unverified.
Local edit task and mask bounds exist, but there is no real mask drawing canvas, mask image payload, or inpaint provider.
Batch rows and export UI exist, but the implementation does not yet run one durable provider job per garment row with retry and per-row result artifacts.
Factory full-chain readiness is blocked by architect readiness, and Kimi-bound roles are not reliable with the current quota state.
Tests pass for current code shape, but there is no Electron E2E or visual test proving upload -> generate -> preview -> edit -> export on real images.

technical_director_assessment.target_current_grade: Runnable V0/V1 prototype with meaningful local runtime foundation, not production-complete commercial AI apparel studio.
technical_director_assessment.estimated_completion: About 55-65% for a desktop prototype; much lower for production-grade AI generation quality and unattended factory proof.
